questions.prompt: Which mental model best explains “Conditional Logic with @if and @else” in Dart Sass?

questions.answer_key: Control-flow rules turn structured Sass values into a predictable set of CSS rules. Choose `@if` for decisions and `@each`, `@for`, or `@while` for iteration when it makes the generated output clearer than writing each rule manually.
questions.explanation: Control-flow rules turn structured Sass values into a predictable set of CSS rules. Choose `@if` for decisions and `@each`, `@for`, or `@while` for iteration when it makes the generated output clearer than writing each rule manually. questions.answer_key: For writing conditional rules, identify the relevant source rule, predict the intended result, and check the emitted CSS against that expectation.
questions.explanation: For writing conditional rules, identify the relevant source rule, predict the intended result, and check the emitted CSS against that expectation. Compare the compiled output with the stated intent and preserve browser-native behavior where it is required.
